note: Opens with an in-fiction press conference: owner Colin Corvitz announces the promotion's own sale back to private ownership, and booker Josh Fieldings addresses public controversy over the prior card's Marx-Scheinberg stoppage, promising a rematch after One Shot at Glory that is not recorded anywhere else in the held record.
